sourceRegister.title: Инструкция по эксплуатации программы vivaCRM
sourceRegister.proves: Feature-level transaction sum/method/status/history, webhook mode, and multiple payment-system integrations.
sourceRegister.limitations: No API schema, identifier lifecycle, idempotency, callback security, consistency, amount unit or currency contract.

sourceRegister.title: Viva CRM official site
sourceRegister.proves: Official product identity and discovery of the operating instruction.
sourceRegister.limitations: No developer portal or API contract was linked.

sourceRegister.title: Viva CRM API root
sourceRegister.proves: The official API host currently requires authentication.
sourceRegister.limitations: No credential was used and no provider semantics were exposed.

sourceRegister.title: Viva CRM Swagger UI legacy entry
sourceRegister.limitations: A protected path is not readable contract evidence.

sourceRegister.title: Viva CRM API docs legacy entry
Viva CRM Springdoc root
sourceRegister.proves: No public schema is served at this path.
sourceRegister.limitations: Does not prove that no authenticated/private schema exists.

sourceRegister.title: Viva CRM Springdoc Admin group
sourceRegister.proves: The previously expected grouped path is not a current public source.

sourceRegister.title: Viva CRM Springdoc config
sourceRegister.proves: No public group/version discovery is available at this path.

sourceRegister.title: WebHook (вебхуки)
sourceRegister.proves: Configured outgoing POST notifications and example org, client, exerciseId and bookingId fields.
sourceRegister.limitations: No documented authentication, signature, replay, event ID, acknowledgement, retry or payment-fact contract; LINK means payment-link notification.

sourceRegister.title: Настройка оповещений
sourceRegister.proves: Webhook is stage 2 or 3 of a notification delivery cascade.

sourceRegister.title: Official Viva Help documentation index
sourceRegister.proves: Indexes S-10 as the dedicated webhook page.
sourceRegister.limitations: Index completeness does not prove private contracts absent.

sourceRegister.title: Отчёт №4 — Транзакции
sourceRegister.proves: A transaction may contain several positions; paid and refund rows may coexist; totals are shown in rubles with separate discount and deposit.
sourceRegister.limitations: Human report, not an API fact contract.

sourceRegister.title: Отчёт №5 — Записи
sourceRegister.proves: Per-booking nominal, discount, deposit and paid totals are shown; entitlement rows can be zero.
sourceRegister.limitations: No API representation or authoritative lifecycle.

sourceRegister.title: События виджетов для Yandex.Метрика
sourceRegister.proves: Success telemetry may be lost when the customer closes the page; failure combines several outcomes.
sourceRegister.limitations: Analytics telemetry is not provider truth.

sourceRegister.title: Обновления
sourceRegister.proves: Partial refunds, recalculated deposits/bonuses/commissions and refund history exist.

sourceRegister.title: Подключение онлайн-платежей (интернет-эквайринг)
sourceRegister.proves: Merchant-side acquiring connections use terminal credentials.
sourceRegister.limitations: No writer, read-back, callback or environment-parity contract.

sourceRegister.title: Депозиты
sourceRegister.proves: Deposit is a separate funding component with history and refund behavior.

sourceRegister.title: Как оплатить длинную запись?
sourceRegister.proves: One payment action may cover a selected or affordable subset of bookings in nearest-first order.
sourceRegister.limitations: No API identity or allocation contract.

requirements.internalInvariant: Immutable intent exists before egress.
requirements.providerQuestion: Which merchant-controlled reference exists before write?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-01 has no API identifiers.
requirements.openQuestion: Exact field, format, uniqueness and retention?

requirements.internalInvariant: Read-back matches the exact provider object.
requirements.providerQuestion: Which order, booking, payment and transaction IDs are generated and returned?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-10 examples include bookingId and exerciseId in notification callbacks, but not their lifecycle or payment identifiers.
requirements.implementationConsequence: Callback-side booking/exercise correlators exist, but no lost-response or payment mapping.
requirements.openQuestion: Lifecycle, uniqueness, retention and availability of every ID?

requirements.internalInvariant: Callback observations require a stable dedupe key.
requirements.providerQuestion: Is there a unique callback event ID?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-01 only states that webhook mode exists.
requirements.openQuestion: Event ID scope and retention?

requirements.internalInvariant: Provider identity is immutable and tenant-scoped.
requirements.providerQuestion: What are identifier uniqueness, retention, reuse and environment differences?
requirements.officialEvidence: No accessible API contract.
requirements.openQuestion: Written production contract required.

requirements.internalInvariant: Lost-response recovery must not repeat a write.
requirements.providerQuestion: Can Viva look up by a pre-write merchant reference?
requirements.officialEvidence: No documented independent lookup.
requirements.openQuestion: Exact endpoint and cardinality?

requirements.internalInvariant: A stable provider idempotency key is supplied.
requirements.providerQuestion: Does the exact create operation support idempotency and where is the key sent?
requirements.officialEvidence: No accessible write reference or OpenAPI.
requirements.openQuestion: Header or field and exact operation?

requirements.internalInvariant: Identical command replay cannot duplicate effect.
requirements.providerQuestion: Does same key plus same payload replay the first result?
requirements.officialEvidence: No official semantic evidence.
requirements.openQuestion: Response replay and status behavior?

requirements.internalInvariant: Changed payload for one key conflicts.
requirements.providerQuestion: Does same key plus changed payload fail with no effect?
requirements.officialEvidence: No official semantic evidence.
requirements.openQuestion: Error/status and no-side-effect guarantee?

requirements.internalInvariant: The key outlives the recovery horizon.
requirements.providerQuestion: What are key uniqueness scope and retention?
requirements.officialEvidence: No official semantic evidence.
requirements.openQuestion: Merchant/account/endpoint scope and TTL?

requirements.internalInvariant: Timeout or reset remains UNKNOWN.
requirements.providerQuestion: Is replay safe after timeout/reset?
requirements.officialEvidence: No ambiguous-outcome contract.
requirements.openQuestion: Is accepted-but-unanswered discoverable without create?

requirements.internalInvariant: Read-back is independent and authoritative.
requirements.providerQuestion: Which production endpoint and identifiers retrieve the exact object?
requirements.officialEvidence: The official API surfaces expose no readable schema.
requirements.openQuestion: Endpoint, auth, lookup fields and cardinality?

requirements.internalInvariant: NOT_FOUND cannot mean rejection.
requirements.providerQuestion: How are never-created, not-yet-visible, deleted and rejected distinguished?
requirements.officialEvidence: No negative lookup or consistency contract.
requirements.gateConsequence: Read-back and rejection side effects NO-GO.
requirements.openQuestion: Consistency window and error model?

requirements.internalInvariant: Terminal facts are monotonic.
requirements.providerQuestion: Which states are terminal and can they reverse?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-13 and S-16 prove that paid and later partial or full refund facts can coexist, but publish no API state machine.
requirements.implementationConsequence: PAID cannot be assumed globally terminal for live convergence.
requirements.openQuestion: Full state machine and event ordering?

requirements.internalInvariant: Tenant, actor, game, payment and reference match exactly.
requirements.providerQuestion: Which fields bind merchant, actor, booking/order/payment and reference?
requirements.officialEvidence: No accessible response schema.
requirements.openQuestion: Required immutable correlation fields?

requirements.internalInvariant: Reconciliation is bounded.
requirements.providerQuestion: What are visibility delay, history retention and rate limits?
requirements.officialEvidence: No official operational limits.
requirements.openQuestion: Production consistency and quotas?

requirements.internalInvariant: Callback input is observation, never synchronous truth.
requirements.providerQuestion: Is a provider-to-merchant HTTP callback transport documented?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-10 and S-11 document configured outgoing POST notifications in a delivery cascade.
requirements.implementationConsequence: Transport existence only; it is not a payment callback contract.
requirements.openQuestion: Is there a separate production payment-event channel?

requirements.internalInvariant: No public ingress without authentication.
requirements.providerQuestion: How is the callback authenticated?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-10 and S-11 prove webhook POST transport but provide no documented authentication mechanism.
requirements.implementationConsequence: Do not create a public route.
requirements.openQuestion: Signature, Basic Auth, mTLS, allowlist or other?

requirements.internalInvariant: Callback observation must have integrity.
requirements.providerQuestion: What signature algorithm, canonical payload and headers are used?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-10 specifies example bodies but no signature, canonicalization or covered headers.
requirements.openQuestion: Exact verification algorithm and key rotation?

requirements.internalInvariant: Replay is bounded independently of dedupe.
requirements.providerQuestion: Is there a signed timestamp or nonce and clock window?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-10 specifies no replay contract.
requirements.openQuestion: Timestamp, nonce and replay window?

requirements.internalInvariant: Terminal state is monotonic and observations dedupe.
requirements.providerQuestion: What are event ID, retries, duplicates, ordering, ACK and non-2xx behavior?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-10 and S-11 explain the notification cascade but not delivery identity, retry, order or acknowledgement semantics.
requirements.openQuestion: Complete delivery and acknowledgement rules?

requirements.internalInvariant: Callback is bound to tenant and merchant.
requirements.providerQuestion: Which signed fields identify merchant and exact object?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-10 examples contain org.id, client, exerciseId and bookingId, but no signature-bound identity or recovery reference.
requirements.implementationConsequence: Unsigned body fields cannot select a trusted tenant or reservation.
requirements.openQuestion: Merchant/reference binding and environment keys?

requirements.internalInvariant: Provider observations must not leak personal data.
requirements.providerQuestion: Does callback payload contain personal data requiring restricted handling?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-10 examples contain phone, email and a client object.
requirements.implementationConsequence: Never log raw bodies or place them in metrics or audit; any retention needs separate access, encryption and deletion review.
requirements.openQuestion: What minimum fields and provider-supported redaction can be used?

requirements.internalInvariant: Canonical minor amount is compared.
requirements.providerQuestion: Are amounts decimal or minor units and how are they rounded?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-01 says transaction sum is displayed but defines no representation.
requirements.openQuestion: Unit, scale, rounding and zero/negative rules?

requirements.internalInvariant: Canonical ISO currency is compared.
requirements.providerQuestion: Which currency field/code is authoritative?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-01 says one integrated gateway supports multiple currencies but defines no Viva currency field.
requirements.openQuestion: ISO alpha/numeric code and source?

requirements.internalInvariant: Authorization, capture, settlement and refund are distinguished.
requirements.providerQuestion: Which lifecycle amounts and partial operations are returned?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-01 lists paid, refund and unpaid UI statuses and transaction history only.
requirements.openQuestion: Authorization, capture, settlement, refund and expiry semantics?

requirements.internalInvariant: One exact payment effect applies per intent.
requirements.providerQuestion: How are fees, tips, reversals, chargebacks and multiple transactions represented?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-01 mentions discounts, commissions and multiple payment integrations, not API facts.
requirements.openQuestion: Multiple and partial transaction model?

requirements.internalInvariant: Confirm only exact merchant/reference/amount/currency match.
requirements.providerQuestion: What exact provider fact is authoritative for this reservation?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-01 documents visible transaction sum/status/history but no immutable API correlation.
requirements.implementationConsequence: Cannot confirm a native Games reservation.
requirements.openQuestion: Exact immutable fact set and provider of record?

requirements.internalInvariant: One exact provider effect is allocated to one intent.
requirements.providerQuestion: Can one transaction or payment cover multiple positions or bookings?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-13 says one transaction may contain several positions; S-19 says one action may cover a selected or affordable subset of bookings.
requirements.implementationConsequence: Require provider-native per-position or per-booking allocation; transaction total equality is unsafe.
requirements.gateConsequence: Live convergence remains NO-GO without allocation IDs.
requirements.openQuestion: Which stable API allocation ID binds one payment position to one booking?

requirements.internalInvariant: Post-payment facts are handled explicitly.
requirements.providerQuestion: Can paid state later be partially or fully refunded?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-13 keeps original paid and refund rows; S-16 documents partial refunds and recalculated components.
requirements.implementationConsequence: Initial admission and later refund or reversal need separate reviewed lifecycles.
requirements.openQuestion: API refund IDs, amounts, ordering and settlement?

requirements.internalInvariant: Browser and UI signals never establish provider truth.
requirements.providerQuestion: Are widget success and failure events authoritative and complete?
requirements.officialEvidence: S-15 says success may be lost and failure combines error, refusal and refund-without-confirmation outcomes.
requirements.implementationConsequence: Map widget events to telemetry or UNKNOWN only.
requirements.openQuestion: Which backend read fact replaces the telemetry?

requirements.internalInvariant: The adapter version is pinned.
requirements.providerQuestion: What current API version, deprecations and changelog apply?
requirements.officialEvidence: Public API paths provide no schema/version and S-01 has product-page dates only.
requirements.implementationConsequence: Cannot pin a real adapter contract.
requirements.openQuestion: Current production OpenAPI and changelog?

requirements.internalInvariant: Synthetic or demo facts cannot prove production.
requirements.providerQuestion: Are demo/sandbox and production contracts identical?
requirements.officialEvidence: No environment-specific provider documentation.
requirements.openQuestion: Written parity statement and version matrix?

requirements.internalInvariant: External calls use provider-valid timeout, retry, backoff and circuit-breaker policy.
requirements.providerQuestion: Which transport and status failures are retryable and what operational limits apply?
requirements.officialEvidence: No accessible official source defines connect/request timeouts, 429 or Retry-After, retry classes, rate-limit scope, backoff/jitter, breaker probes, maintenance behavior or SLO.
requirements.implementationConsequence: A real or shadow adapter cannot safely schedule provider calls.
requirements.openQuestion: Exact production error taxonomy, quotas, retry horizon and breaker recovery contract?

requirements.internalInvariant: Recovery metrics and logs are bounded, redacted and failure-isolated.
requirements.providerQuestion: Which provider correlation fields and operational labels may be retained safely?
requirements.officialEvidence: Accessible official sources publish no logging or telemetry field classification, correlation retention or per-tenant/acquirer isolation contract.
requirements.implementationConsequence: Define low-cardinality metrics, forbidden PII/merchant/reference/body fields and tenant/acquirer failure isolation before adapter work.
requirements.openQuestion: Permitted correlation, redaction, retention, metric labels and isolation boundaries?

realProviderWriter.reason: No proven idempotency or safe ambiguous-write recovery.

realProviderReadBack.reason: No independent authoritative lookup by a pre-write merchant reference.

publicCallbackRoute.reason: Authentication, integrity and replay resistance are unproven.

callbackAsAccelerationOnly.reason: Authenticated ingress and independent read-back are both unproven.

providerNativeAmountCurrencyVerification.reason: Amount, currency, merchant and reference API facts are unproven.

livePaymentConvergence.reason: Writer, read-back and exact payment verification are closed.

SHADOW.reason: No real provider read fact suitable for comparison.

WARN.reason: No trustworthy comparison fact or production parity.

BLOCK.reason: No authoritative provider fact can deny or mutate user state.

questionsRequiringWrittenProviderConfirm: After the exact create request is accepted but its response body is lost, which merchant-controlled pre-write value retrieves precisely that object without repeating create?
For the exact create operation, what is the idempotency key location, uniqueness scope, retention, same-payload replay, changed-payload behavior, timeout/reset behavior and post-retention behavior?

Which current production read endpoint looks up by the merchant-controlled value, what is its cardinality, how are never-created, not-yet-visible, deleted, expired and rejected distinguished, and what are the consistency window, history retention and rate limits?
List every order, booking, payment and transaction identifier, its first availability, scope, retention, reuse and production/demo differences.
Provide the current production booking/payment state machine and identify terminal and reversible statuses.
Which immutable read-back fields bind merchant, actor, exercise, booking/order/payment, merchant reference and provider transaction?
Specify authoritative amount unit, scale, rounding and currency representation plus lifecycle, partial, fee, net, tip, reversal and chargeback facts.
Provide callback signature/authentication, canonical payload, covered headers, timestamp/nonce, replay window, key rotation, environment separation and signed merchant/reference fields.
Provide callback event-ID scope, retries, duplicate/order guarantees, old-after-new behavior, acknowledgement and non-2xx handling.
Provide current production OpenAPI/reference and changelog URLs, supported version, deprecation policy and written demo/production parity.

Define production connect/request timeout expectations, 429 and Retry-After, retryable versus nonretryable status and transport classes, rate-limit scope, maximum retry rate and horizon, backoff and jitter, circuit-breaker trip/half-open/recovery probes, read-after-write consistency, maintenance behavior and provider SLOs.

Define permitted provider correlation values in logs/traces, retention and redaction, forbidden merchant/reference/client/body fields, allowed low-cardinality metric labels and failure/rate-limit/circuit isolation per tenant, merchant and acquiring integration.
nextPermittedPackage: Provider clarification package with redacted, provenance-preserving written Viva answers and current production OpenAPI/reference; no real adapter implementation.
